value.answer: Honda Odyssey, for me. U.S. News gives the 2026 one 9.3/10, Car Talk says it keeps coming out on top in their tests, it has the biggest max cargo room at 155.8 cu ft, and it drives most like a car. The catch: Edmunds ranks the Sienna first, and the Sienna's 36 mpg beats everything if fuel costs matter most to you. The reviewers don't agree, so it's my pick, not a settled winner.
